text:
I find myself surrounded by an atmosphere of curiosity and intellect. The transparent walls and modern design of the first space evoke a sense of openness and potential for collaboration. Here, thought and discussion seem encouraged, yet the emptiness of the room adds a touch of solitude, making me feel like both observer and participant in anticipation of ideas yet to be shared. 

Upon entering the exhibit space in the second scene, the bold colors and typography—R+D, research and development—rouse my philosophical curiosity about innovation and knowledge. This immersive environment makes me reflect on how we shape, document, and share human thought. I feel stimulated and contemplative, pleased to witness evidence of minds working together to expand understanding.
